[User]: Hi there, I have a quick question about recurring tasks in the web app.

I set up a daily recurring task in one of our team projects, but the reminder keeps showing up an hour earlier than the time I chose. It’s not a huge problem, just a bit confusing, and I’m not sure if I’m misunderstanding how the time settings work.

rounds.response: Hi there — sorry that your daily reminder is coming an hour early; that is understandably confusing. This usually happens when your account/project time zone, your device/browser time zone, or a calendar integration setting don't match (or after a daylight‑saving shift), because reminders are scheduled in one zone and converted to another. Please check your Profile Settings for your account time zone, the Project Settings for a project-level time zone, and your computer/browser and calendar time zone; if they differ, set them to the correct zone and re-open the recurring task (you may need to re-save the recurrence for the change to apply). If those all match but the reminder is still off, try logging out and back in or clearing your browser cache, and temporarily disable calendar sync to see if the calendar is shifting the time. If you’d like, tell me which time zones are shown in your profile and on your device (or the project name) and I’ll help pinpoint the mismatch.

I see that the Date header shows the email was sent at 07:00 UTC, while your task is set for 09:00 local time (08:00 UTC), meaning the email was sent an hour early. rounds.response: Hi — thanks for sharing the headers and for checking everything so thoroughly. The Date header (07:00 UTC) is one hour earlier than the app’s expected 08:00 UTC for your 9:00 local time, which strongly suggests our email-scheduling service is applying the wrong UTC/DST offset when it stamps emails. I can escalate this to our engineering team with the headers you provided — please confirm the account email (or user ID), the project name, and the example task name + scheduled date so we can match logs. As a temporary workaround you can disable email reminders for that task or set the email reminder an hour later, since in-app/mobile notifications are delivering at the correct time. Once you send the details I’ll open the escalation including the headers and next steps.
